strings.zh: 下面是自行车道{SCROLL}乘自行车飞奔下去{NEWLINE}真是太爽了！{SCROLL}什么高速船,什么列车,{NEWLINE}也许很多人更愿意乘坐{CLEAR}这些舒适、帅气的交通工具,{CLEAR}可你喜欢自行车吧？
strings.en: Cycling Road starts here.{NEWLINE}It’s all downhill, so it’s totally{CLEAR}exhilarating.{SCROLL}Some people prefer comfortable and cool{NEWLINE}transportation such as the Fast Ship{CLEAR}and the Magnet Train.{CLEAR}You prefer the Bicycle, don’t you?
strings.notes: US 0356/0 | RV013: meaning: 舒适 = comfortable

strings.zh: 嘿！那个谁！站住！{SCROLL}不骑自行车的人{NEWLINE}不能进入自行车道！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hey! You there! Stop right there!{SCROLL}You have to be on a Bicycle to go on{NEWLINE}the Cycling Road!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0356/1 | RV013: omission: 嘿！那个谁！ restored

strings.zh: 你好啊小伙子,{NEWLINE}我刚刚接到浅红市狩猎场的电话,{CLEAR}说是有一只珍贵的精灵得了重病,{CLEAR}需要我这里的秘药才能治好。{CLEAR}我腿脚不灵活走不了自行车道,{CLEAR}麻烦你帮我把药送过去吧。
strings.en: Hello there, young man. I just got a{NEWLINE}call from the Safari Zone in Fuchsia{CLEAR}City. A precious Pokémon there has{CLEAR}fallen seriously ill, and only the Secret{CLEAR}Potion I make can cure it.{SCROLL}My legs aren’t nimble enough for the{NEWLINE}Cycling Road. Could you please deliver{CLEAR}the medicine there for me?
strings.notes: #2 (young man) / #4 (young lady): male/female player variants. Starts the Secret Potion delivery down the Cycling Road (0350 bike gang roadblock).

strings.zh: 最近自行车道上{NEWLINE}好像有一些年轻人喜欢霸占道路,{CLEAR}你不要管他们,请尽快把药送过去。{CLEAR}事关精灵的生死,要快啊。
strings.en: Lately some young people have been{NEWLINE}hogging the Cycling Road. Don’t mind{CLEAR}them. Please deliver the medicine as{CLEAR}fast as you can.{SCROLL}A Pokémon’s life is at stake. Hurry!

strings.zh: 你好啊小姑娘,{NEWLINE}我刚刚接到浅红市狩猎场的电话,{CLEAR}说是有一只珍贵的精灵得了重病,{CLEAR}需要我这里的秘药才能治好。{CLEAR}我腿脚不灵活走不了自行车道,{CLEAR}麻烦你帮我把药送过去吧。

A precious Pokémon there has{CLEAR}fallen seriously ill, and only the Secret{CLEAR}Potion I make can cure it.{SCROLL}My legs aren’t nimble enough for the{NEWLINE}Cycling Road.
